tool.help:
**Cambrian-1: Multimodal Biological Vision-Language Model**
Cambrian-1 is a vision-language model trained on biological images for automated image analysis.
**Supported Image Types:** - Microscopy (fluorescence, brightfield, electron) - Gel electrophoresis - Western blots - Flow cytometry plots - Histopathology
**Analysis Tasks:** - **Describe**: Generate natural language description - **Count**: Count cells, colonies, bands - **Segment**: Identify regions of interest - **Classify**: Categorize image type/phenotype - **QA**: Answer specific questions
**Citation:** Cambrian-1: Vision-Centric Exploration of Multimodal LLMs (2024)
